responsibility: Runs the fixed native-tool checks of the selected profiles against designated fixtures or adopting implementations and returns signed, revision-bound evidence and run records.
owns: The built-in runner for every check definition and the required/optional probe policy.
Isolated per-run temporary directories and disposable fixture databases.
Tool discovery, version recording and evidence signing with the runner key named by policy.
boundary: Never installs a tool and never executes command text drawn from a model, a source file or configuration.
Executes only in an environment the policy designates.
A missing or unreadable tool yields UNKNOWN, never PASS.

provides.name: runChecks
provides.concurrency: Each run uses its own temporary directory and fixture database; parallel runs never share state.

provides.name: verifyRevisionSet
provides.concurrency: Read-only comparison of every component's evidence against one coordinated revision set.
